dispositionCodes.PROVISIONAL_DIRECT_TARGET: Metadata supports a direct receptor–VHH target, but formal leakage and construct gates are not yet all complete.
dispositionCodes.EXCLUDE_AUXILIARY_BINDER: The antibody domain supports another complex component rather than directly benchmarking receptor–VHH docking.
dispositionCodes.EXCLUDE_NO_DIRECT_RECEPTOR_VHH_INTERFACE: No source-backed direct receptor–VHH interface is established.
dispositionCodes.EXCLUDE_FUSION_DOMINATED_INTERFACE: Binding is dominated by an engineered fusion or scaffold.
dispositionCodes.EXCLUDE_ENGINEERED_EPITOPE_GRAFT: The receptor construct grafts or creates a development-derived epitope.
dispositionCodes.EXCLUDE_RECEPTOR_CLUSTER_LEAKAGE: The receptor is connected to development or another holdout component under the frozen receptor rule.
dispositionCodes.EXCLUDE_VHH_CLUSTER_OR_PARENT_LEAKAGE: The VHH is connected by sequence cluster or source-backed parent/variant provenance.
dispositionCodes.EXCLUDE_PUBLICATION_LEAKAGE: The primary publication is shared with development or another holdout component.
dispositionCodes.EXCLUDE_ANNOTATION_EPITOPE_LEAKAGE: The source-backed annotation epitope is connected under the frozen ontology.
dispositionCodes.EXCLUDE_AMBIGUOUS_EVIDENCE: Required direct-interface, construct, publication, sequence, or epitope evidence is missing or contradictory.
dispositionCodes.SAME_COMPONENT_NOT_ADDITIONAL: The entry is eligible only as another structure within an already represented connected component.
dispositionCodes.PENDING_REQUIRED_METADATA: The row is not disposition-complete because required public metadata is not yet available.
